adapter.name: BookDataAdapter
adapter.description: Adapter interface for providing Book data to SBBox-BookCatalog.

book_id.description: Stable identifier of the Book requested by SBBox-BookCatalog.

book.description: Logical Book data conforming to the BookCatalog domain model.

rules: The adapter must implement the BookDataSource contract.
The adapter receives a stable book identifier.
The adapter returns logical Book data.
The adapter must not modify BookCatalog business rules.
The adapter must not control page navigation.
The adapter must not control narration playback.
The adapter must not resolve narration provider resources.
The adapter must not render images.
Technology-specific implementation details must remain inside the adapter.
The adapter exposes WHAT Book data is available through the contract, while owning HOW that data is accessed.
